verdict.rationale: Downloadable forms and instructions are a fair question for a company registry, so the axis applies, but the pack never shows Companies House offering downloadable forms or form guidance without an account. The only reference to paper forms ([companies-house-docs-17]) is about filing online instead of posting them, not downloading them. The keyless GOV.UK content API probe returns a general 'set-up-business' guidance page from the host GOV.UK platform, not Companies House's own forms or instructions, so it earns no credit.
